versions.changelog:
Expanded to support both KylinOS V11 (Wayland/wlcctrl) and V10SP1 (X11/xdotool):

- Added OS detection script; backend is auto-selected for each platform.
- Separated fast-path usage and command examples for V11 and V10SP1.
- Introduced new scripts for X11 automation (click, drag, double-click, info).
- Clarified coordinate calculations for both Wayland (scale-aware) and X11 (pixel).
- Documented platform-specific command details, limitations, and required tools.

- Initial release of the skill for GUI automation on KylinOS V11 Desktop using wlcctrl.
- Supports fast path scripts for inspecting outputs, launching/focusing apps, finding target windows, and performing keyboard/mouse actions.
- Handles scale-aware coordinate conversion for accurate clicks, drags, and window movement.
- Provides warnings and clarification about wlcctrl man page inaccuracies for coordinate and movement commands.
- Lists essential wlcctrl commands, usage patterns, and important configuration tips for efficient GUI automation.
- Includes notes for multi-monitor setups, window management best practices, and performance tips.
